sections.Profile:
"Monday Night Football" is a pinball machine released by Data East USA, Inc. in September 1989. It features a football theme with two flippers, three ramps, and a three-ball multiball mode. Designed by Ed Cebula and Joe Kaminkow, with artwork by Kevin O'Connor and sound by David Thiel, the game was produced in a limited run of 1,492 units.
